topic: Claude 300K Output Tokens Guide: Batch API for Large Code Generation 2026

competitors.title: Batch Processing — Claude API Docs (Official)
key_points: Message Batches API supports up to 100,000 requests or 256 MB per batch, processed asynchronously within ~1 hour
Extended Output beta (`output-300k-2026-03-24`) raises max_tokens cap to 300,000 for batch requests using Opus 4.8, 4.7, 4.6, or Sonnet 4.6
Batch pricing is 50% of standard API prices across all supported models
Supports vision, tool use (including server tools: web search, web fetch, code execution, MCP connectors), extended thinking, and multi-turn conversations in batch
Batch results available for 29 days; batches expire if processing doesn't complete within 24 hours
Extended output only available on Message Batches API (synchronous Messages API limited to 64k-128k depending on model)
A single 300K-token generation can take over an hour to complete

competitors.title: Extended Thinking — Claude API Docs (Official)
key_points: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 support up to 128K output tokens; Opus 4.8, 4.7, 4.6 support 128K output tokens
Extended thinking gives Claude enhanced reasoning for complex tasks with varying transparency levels
Manual extended thinking is deprecated on newer models in favor of adaptive thinking with effort parameter
Interleaved thinking enables Claude to think between tool calls for sophisticated multi-step reasoning
Previous thinking blocks are auto-stripped from context window for subsequent turns, preserving token capacity
With `display: omitted`, thinking tokens are still billed but not streamed — reduces time-to-first-text-token

competitors.title: Context Windows — Claude API Docs (Official)
key_points: Claude Opus 4.8, Mythos Preview, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 4.6 have 1M-token context windows
Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 have 1M-token context windows (default), with 128K max_tokens per request
Context awareness in Sonnet 4.6/4.5 and Haiku 4.5 lets models track remaining token budget throughout conversations
Server-side compaction available for Fable 5, Mythos 5, Opus 4.8, Mythos Preview, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 4.6
When input tokens + max_tokens exceed context window, newer models stop with stop_reason 'model_context_window_exceeded'

competitors.title: Effective Harnesses for Long-Running Agents — Anthropic Engineering Blog
key_points: Two-part solution: initializer agent (first session) + coding agent (subsequent sessions with incremental progress)
Feature list file with 200+ features marked passing/failing prevents premature completion declarations
Incremental progress per session with git commits and claude-progress.txt file for cross-session continuity
Testing with Puppeteer MCP browser automation catches bugs not visible from code alone
Key failure modes: one-shotting, premature completion, leaving bugs, not knowing how to run the app

competitors.title: Claude Code Overview — Official Docs
key_points: Claude Code available on Terminal CLI, VS Code, Desktop app, Web, and JetBrains
Supports 16+ parallel agents, 1M token context window, CLAUDE.md files for persistent instructions
Routines for recurring scheduling, Channels for external event integration (Telegram, Discord, webhooks)
CI/CD integrations via GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD for automated PR reviews and issue triage
Agent SDK for building custom agent workflows

A Message Batch is limited to 100,000 Message requests or 256 MB per batch, whichever is reached first
Most batches complete within 1 hour; batches expire if processing doesn't complete within 24 hours
Batch results are available for 29 days after creation
Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 4.6 have 1M-token context windows
Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 have 1M-token context windows with 128K max_tokens per request
A single 300K-token generation can take over an hour to complete on the batch API
Multi-agent systems use ~15× more tokens than chat interactions; single agents use ~4× more than chats
Programmatic tool calling reduces average token usage from 43,588 to 27,297 (37% reduction) on complex research tasks
Extended output is available on Claude API and Claude Platform on AWS, but not on Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Microsoft Foundry
Sub-agents in multi-agent architectures return condensed summaries of 1,000-2,000 tokens from 10,000+ token explorations
Claude Code supports 16+ parallel agents with 1M token context window for complex workflows
Extended output supports: book-length drafts, technical documentation, exhaustive structured data extraction, large code-generation scaffolds, and long reasoning chains
